name: He has bigger fish to fry

meaning.zh:
“他有更重要的事情要做” 或 “他有更大的事要忙”。

这个短语起源于17世纪，当时人们用 “bigger fish to fry” 来形容有比当前事情更重要的任务。这个表达方式源自烹饪领域，当有更大或更重要的鱼要煮时，人们通常会把较小的问题放在一边。
meaning.en: This idiom originated in the 17th century when people used "bigger fish to fry" to describe having more important tasks than the current one. The phrase comes from the culinary world, where if one has a bigger or more important fish to cook, smaller problems are usually set aside.

lines.en: He didn't attend the meeting because he has bigger fish to fry at the moment.
lines.zh: 他没有参加会议，因为他现在有更重要的事情要处理。

lines.en: Sure, you can ask him for help, but he might have bigger fish to fry.
lines.zh: 当然，你可以请他帮忙，但他可能有更重要的事情要做。

lines.en: Don't bother him with that issue; he has bigger fish to fry.
lines.zh: 别用那个问题打扰他了，他有更重要的事要忙。
